api_list.name: /AmberWaves Retrieve Paged Collection
api_list.description: Retrieves a paged collection of amber waves content nodes filtered by a particular section alias, ordered by descending release date.

required_parameters.name: alias
required_parameters.description: A string parameter that specifies a series alias used for filtering. (FromUri)

required_parameters.name: start
required_parameters.description: A zero-index integer parameter that specifies the desired starting index (0 for page 1, 100 for page 2, etc...) (FromUri)

required_parameters.name: size
required_parameters.description: An integer parameter that specifies the desired page size. (FromUri)
